MissionCommands.Message: Welcome to the Apollo 16 Flight Plan mission, and thank you for testing the Flight Plan Mission mode.

Use the Command Module (AoH) → Mission Details checklist for the suggested/reference burn times and mission schedule. Each flight will be slightly different, so treat these values as planning references rather than exact targets. Plan and execute your mission as closely as practical, but adjust the timeline and burns as needed for your own trajectory.
[Complete the TIMELINE -> Pre-Launch: Launch Preparations checks]
[Follow the TIMELINE -> Ascent: Boost checklist (PAGE L/2-7) ]
The Z-torquing angle will be plus 0.06. Over.
[Complete the TIMELINE -> Insertion: Post Insertion and System Checks (Item 1 - 31, PAGE L/2-11)]
[Ground is working on the TLI parameters and will be communicated at approximately 002:00 GET]
[ Verify DAP 31102, 01111 ]
[ Open TLI planner and plan a TLI burn at GET ~002:33:00 (TB6 ~02:23:57) to reach a Lunar Pe of 60 nmi alt, etimated LOI at GET ~074:30:00 ]
[ Start TLI PREPARATION (PAGE L/2-27) and complete the burn. ]
[ Burn complete, proceed with the checklist. S-IVB will maneuver to sep attitude at 002:54:20. S-IVB sep planned at 003:04:20. ]
[ Complete the TIMELINE -> T&D: PRE CSM SEPARATION PREP checklist (PAGE L/3-1) ]
[ S-IVB maneuvering to sep attitude.]
[ Complete the TIMELINE -> T&D: CSM SEPARATION PREP checklist (PAGE L/3-1) ]
[ Follow the TIMELINE -> T&D: CSM SEPARATION checklist (PAGE L/3-2) to separate at 003:04:20. ]
[ Complete the checklist for TRANSPOSITION, then follow the TIMELINE -> T&D: DOCKING checklist (PAGE L/3-2) to dock before 003:14:20. ]
[ Complete the TIMELINE -> T&D: POST DOCKING checklist (PAGE L/3-4). ]
[ Complete the TIMELINE -> T&D: CM/LM PRESSURE EQUALIZATION checklist (PAGE L/3-5). ]
[ Complete the TIMELINE -> T&D: TUNNEL HATCH REMOVAL checklist (PAGE L/3-5). ]
[ Complete the TIMELINE -> T&D: LM UMBILICAL CONNECTIONS checklist (PAGE L/3-5). ]
[ Complete the TIMELINE -> T&D: HATCH INSTALLATION checklist (PAGE L/3-5). ]
[ Complete the TIMELINE -> T&D: PRE LM SEP & EJECTION checklist (PAGE L/3-5). CSM/LM EJECTION at 003:59:20 ]
[ Follow the TIMELINE -> T&D: LM SEP & EJECTION checklist (PAGE L/3-6) eject from the S-IVB at 003:59:20 ]
[ Complete the TIMELINE -> T&D: POST LM EJECTION checklist (PAGE L/3-6) ]
[ Maneuver to view S-IVB in HATCH WINDOW by 04:12:00 ]
[ S-IVB YAW MNVR ]
[ S-IVB APS EVASIVE BURN ]
[ Charge Battery B (TIMELINE -> SYSTEMS 1: EPS -> Battery Charging) ]
[ Use CREW MEMBERS -> Request REFSMMATs -> Request PTC REFSMMAT ]
[ P52, Option 3 (LAUNCH ORIENT) ]
[ P52, Option 1 (PTC ORIENT) ]
[ Complete a GDC ALIGN to align the GDC with the IMU containing the new PTC ORIENT ]
[ CSM SYSTEMS CHECK: DEACTIVATE PRIMARY EVAP (PAGE S/1-6) ]
[ P52, Option 3 (PTC ORIENT) + GDC ALIGN ]
[ No MCC-1 ]
[ Vent batteries until system test 7A = 0 ]
[ LiOH canister change: A ]
[ Maneuver to center Earth in window and photograph it ]
[ Follow the TIMELINE -> G&C 7 - PTC/ORBRATE -> (V79) ORBRATE/PTC to set up the PTC roll at 0, 270, 0 ]
[ TIMELINE -> SYSTEMS 1 - GENERAL -> PRE-SLEEP CHECKLIST (PAGE S/1-29) ]
[ Configure: H2 HEATERS 1&2 - AUTO (VERIFY); H2 FANS 3 - AUTO; O2 HEATERS 1&2 - OFF; O2 HEATERS 3 - AUTO ]
[ Wake up time: 023:00:00 ]
[ TIMELINE -> SYSTEMS 1 - GENERAL -> POST-SLEEP CHECKLIST (PAGE S/1-29) ]
[ Charge Battery A (CM AOH -> SYSTEMS: EPS -> Battery Charging) - follow the coasting and house keeping schedule as written in the Mission Details checklist from now on.]

[You have reached the Lunar Sphere of Influence. The real Apollo 16 mission had an issue with the SPS circulation burn after DOI, causing delays and flight plan changes. The rest of the mission is designed to allow you to make some of these decisions yourself. You can use the burn parameters from the Mission Details checklist as a reference when planning burns.]
[Plan and execute the LOI burn with a target Ap of 170 nmi and a Pe of 60 nmi]
[ LOI-1 ignition ]
[ LOI-1 complete ]
[ Reach the DOI orbit required to land in the Descartes Highlands (8.97301°S 15.50019°E). You can decide where to land but use this landing site as a reference. ]
[ Prepare and undock the LM from the CM, with the goal of LM UNDOCK at GETI 096:13:30 ]
[ Complete the undocking procedures, then circulate the CSM orbit to 60 x 60 nmi alt orbit while preparing for the PDI (scheduled GETI 098:46:42). Land on the Moon. ]
[ Three EVAs are planned, EVA-1 (102:25-109:25), EVA-2 (124:50-131:50) and EVA-3 (148:25-155:25). Complete the EVAs and the ascent (originally scheduled for GETI ~171 hours) ]
[ Complete the LM TIMELINE: POST DOCKING checklist ]
[ Complete the LM TIMELINE: CONFIG LM FOR JETT checklist ]
[ Complete the LM TIMELINE: IVT TO CM checklist ]
[ Complete the CM TIMELINE: LM UNDOCKING checklist to jettison the LM. As an optional reference, the planned LM JETTISON time is at GETI = 177:33:15. ]
[ LM JETTISON complete. ]

[The planned TEI burn is at GETI 222:20, with entry at approximately MET 290:00. Begin preparing your TEI burn using the values suggested for your flight. There is no need to match the historical trajectory exactly, but you may fine-tune the burn to aim for a similar entry time if you wish.]
[TEI burn requested. Configure DAP-R1=10111 R2=11111 and execute the burn.]
[You have reached the Earth Sphere of Influence (SOI). Establish PTC. ]
[Perform a Mid-Course Correction if needed. Pe should be in the Earth Atmosphere at ~22nmi altitude.]
[Entry preparations will start at EI -5 hours]
[Time to Entry is ~5 hours. Start the TIMELINE -> LUNAR RETURN: VEHICLE PREPARATION checklist followed by the TIMELINE -> LUNAR RETURN: SUPERCIRCULAR ENTRY and execute a safe entry]
[Prepare for atmospheric flight and landing.]
[Splashdown! Congratulations on completing the Apollo 16 Flight Plan Mode mission, great job!]

Title: APOLLO 16 (FLIGHT PLAN)
Description: The crew of Apollo 16 is in the process of preparing the craft for ascent.
